Anders Hallberg decreased its stake in Medtronic Plc (MDT) by 58.34% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Healthinvest Partners Ab who had been investing in Medtronic Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $115.51 billion market cap company.
